transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because… I know this is going to sound hard to explain, but I’ve been really convinced that one of my MBA classmates and this startup advisor are sort of quietly coordinating opportunities for me. Like certain comments in class, or messages on Slack, feel like coded signals about where my career is supposed to go.
Do you believe for certain that these comments and messages are deliberate coded signals meant specifically for you?

Yes. I mean… I know it probably sounds strange, but I do feel certain that they’re deliberate. The comments in class and some of the Slack messages feel like they’re meant specifically for me, like they’re pointing me toward certain career moves or opportunities.
Have you heard voices or sounds that other people don’t seem to hear?

Yeah… a few times a week, usually when I’m up late working on school stuff or operations plans, I’ll hear my name really clearly. Sometimes it’s just a short phrase, like “go now.” It sounds real enough that I check my phone or look around the room, but no one’s there.
Have you had a period when you felt unusually high, euphoric, or excessively energized?

Yeah. Most days lately I’ve felt really switched on, like unusually optimistic and energized, like I’m right on the edge of something big happening. But it’s not all good — I’ve also been snapping at people, like teammates or my boyfriend, over small delays or little things that normally wouldn’t bother me.
Lately, have you been needing much less sleep than usual and still feeling full of energy?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had some late nights, but I haven’t been tracking my sleep closely. I can’t say for certain that I need much less sleep and still feel totally energized.
Have you been much more driven than usual to start or push ahead with projects or plans?

Yes. I’ve been taking on a lot more than usual — starting extra work projects, rewriting team processes for class, reaching out to people from networking events, trying to organize everyone’s schedules. It feels productive at the time, but some of it has actually made me miss normal follow-through on my real tasks.
Have the voices or coded messages ever happened during a time when you were not feeling unusually energized or optimistic?

No, I don’t think so. Before this whole stretch of feeling so energized and pushing so hard with school and work stuff, I never had messages feel coded like that, and I didn’t hear my name when no one was there. That only started after my mood and workload intensity shifted with the MBA prerequisites.
During this energized period, have you been talking much more than usual or feeling hard to stop once you start talking?

Yes, I think so. People have told me I’m talking too fast in meetings and study groups. And I notice once I start explaining an idea, it’s hard for me to stop — even if someone tries to jump in, I’ll keep going because the pause feels like I’m losing momentum.
